title: plugin-detail: `record:details` edit mode offers no editor for a markdown field, so a markdown field that no form names cannot be edited at all (moved from objectstack-ai/objectstack#21543, item 2)
body:
Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`). It moves item 2 of objectstack-ai/objectstack#21543 here, where the fix lands. That card was filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`session_01ER8ntXZhYebyQ66aXWdjfT`) from a measured run. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Graded here: `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue`.

## Measured (hotcrm on `@objectstack/*` 17.6.0, Chromium)

- Opportunities › any deal › Details › the pencil (edit mode).
- Select, boolean, date, currency and textarea fields get editors, and their saves read back over REST.
- **Markdown fields stay `—`, with 0 editors per markdown cell.** These are `description`, and on hotcrm PR #1950 three narrative fields.
- **Control:** a markdown field that a form names explicitly does get an editor in the Edit dialog.
- **Consequence on hotcrm `main` today:** `crm_opportunity.description` is in no opportunity form, so it has no UI editing surface.

## Where (read at `origin/main` `160c6c6eaf`)

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineFieldInput.tsx`, `INLINE_PLAIN_TEXT_FIELD_TYPES`. Its docblock says `markdown` / `html` / `richtext` are absent "because the hosts never open an editor for them at all", under the fields package's shared exclusion (#4228).
- A markdown value is already a string, so a multi-line plain editor loses nothing. That is the condition the docblock's lossless "Class D" states.

## Ruling

- `markdown` gets the multi-line editor `textarea` already uses in `record:details` edit mode. It is lossless for a stored string.
- `html` and `richtext` stay excluded, unchanged.
- The claim reads #4228's reason for excluding markdown first. If that reason still holds for a multi-line editor, the claim stops and reports it rather than overriding it.
- The type-coverage drift guard (`__tests__/inlineEditTypeCoverage.test.tsx`) moves `markdown` into its bucket.
- **Pins:**
  - a markdown field in edit mode gets an editor, and its save reads back unchanged, newlines included;
  - `html` and `richtext` still open none.

**Why p2.** A field type has no inline editor. A form that names the field is a workaround.

## Related

The companion card for item 1 (the tabbed form dialog drops `{ group }` sections) is filed in the same act. objectstack-ai/objectstack#21543's closing comment links both. Together the two leave some fields with no editing surface at all.

**Dedupe:** MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped, for 「record:details inline edit markdown field no editor」 → 0 hits.
